title: Shopping doesn't end at checkout
summary: Our direction for order organization, status checks, and easier returns.
body: Product discovery is only the beginning of a shopping experience. After checkout, people still need to know where their purchases are and what to do if something doesn't work out.
We're developing Spresso around those later tasks too, including organization of purchase information, order-status workflows and assistance with returns.
The exact integrations and supported merchants will be described as they become available. We'll distinguish features under development from those people can use today.
Our aim is to make the entire shopping journey easier to manage, not just the moment when someone clicks Buy.
